title: Introduce delta dependency checker and lightweight presubmit bootstrap
author: Lina Ortega
release_notes: Adds a delta-aware dependency verifier to presubmit and switches the presubmit entrypoint to a lightweight Go bootloader; no user-facing API changes.
description: Context and motivation: Our presubmit pipeline has grown slow due to repeated full dependency scans and heavyweight Python entrypoints in CI containers. This PR introduces a delta dependency checker that only validates changed dependency graphs (module manifests and lockfile regions touched by the PR) and replaces the monolithic presubmit startup script with a compact Go-based bootstrap binary to reduce setup overhead. Goals: 1) reduce presubmit wall time on typical PRs by ~30-50%, 2) provide a safer dependency-gating signal that avoids blocking non-dep changes, 3) make presubmit more hermetic and easier to maintain. Summary of changes: - Add tools/dep-delta-checker: Go CLI that computes changed package/lockfile regions against main, runs a targeted set of validations (license checks, semantic minor/major bump detection, pinned transitive changes) and emits a concise JSON report consumed by CI. - Replace .github/presubmit-entrypoint.sh with .github/presubmit-bootstrap (Go binary invocation) that initializes minimal toolchain, primes cache, and invokes language-specific linters/test selectors. - Introduce presubmit profiles in .ci/profiles.yaml and wire conditional fast-lane/slow-lane execution based on delta-checker output. - Add integration tests for the delta checker under eval-harness/ci-integration which run small fixture repos and assert expected gating decisions. - Update GitHub Actions workflows: .github/workflows/presubmit.yml now calls the bootstrap and parses JSON report; staged fastlane executes when delta-checker yields "dep-skip". - Documentation: docs/ci/delta-deps.md and docs/ci/presubmit-bootloader.md with operational runbook and how to interpret reports. Checklist: - [x] Implement delta checker CLI and unit tests - [x] Swap in Go bootstrap and update Dockerfiles for slim images - [x] Wire CI workflow to consume delta checker output and gate presubmit lanes - [x] Add integration tests and smoke workflow step - [x] Update docs and add runbook Observability and metrics: The delta checker emits sparse metrics (scan_duration_ms, files_inspected, decisions:dep-skip|dep-validate) to the CI telemetry endpoint; presubmit bootstrap records boot_duration_ms and cache_hit boolean. Migration notes: Rollout is staged — default behavior remains conservative (full dep validation) unless opt-in label [ci:fast-deps] is present; after 1 week we will enable fast-lane by default for small PRs (<50 LOC changed and <10 files touched). Security considerations: Go bootstrap runs with minimal privileges; the delta checker respects existing SBOM and license policies and fails closed if lockfile parsing errors occur. Related work items: ENG-2345 (presubmit perf), ENG-2420 (dep safety gate), RFC-4476 (presubmit profiles). Commits: - feat(ci): add dep-delta-checker CLI and unit tests - chore(ci): replace presubmit entrypoint with Go bootstrap binary - test(ci): add integration fixtures and harness for delta checks - ci(workflow): consume delta checker JSON and add fast-lane gating - docs(ci): presubmit runbook and delta-deps usage Notes on CI runs: First GitHub Actions run failed on an intermittent network fetch inside the integration runner; tests were re-run and passed. A linting complaint was raised about missing error wrapping in one helper — addressed in a follow-up commit. Review conversation (high level): - Marcus Holt (2024-11-16): "Nice reduction in script complexity. Can we guarantee the delta checker handles monorepo nested manifests?" — Lina: "Yes, delta checker walks changed paths and applies manifest logic per module root; added unit test for nested modules." - Priya Raman (2024-11-17): "Concerned about false-negatives when lockfile changes are unrelated to code changes." — Lina: "Added conservative heuristic: if lockfile changed but no manifest change, we fall back to full validation unless the lockfile diff is only metadata lines; documented the heuristic." - Diego Navarro (2024-11-18): "Can we surface the JSON report in the Action UI?" — Lina: "Workflow now uploads the JSON as an artifact and annotates the PR with a short summary comment when dep validation runs." CI checks: - build: pass - unit-tests: pass - integration-smoke: pass (flaky before rerun) - lint: pass after fix Merge outcome: squashed and merged into main (Squash merge), PR closed by merge commit 8f9b3a2. Post-merge actions: - Deploy lightweight presubmit bootstrap image to CI runner pool (rolling) - Monitor presubmit median wall time for 72h and report back in ENG-2345 thread - Follow-up: enable default fast-lane after monitoring window and adjust thresholds if necessary.

notes: This PR intentionally keeps the conservative fallback to avoid silent dep misses. After rollout we will iterate on heuristics and consider heuristics telemetry for auto-tuning.
